rows.grounds: locative of ordinal tṛtīya indicating the third division
compound dala-madhya denoting the middle parts of the petals
locative of ordinal turīya indicating the fourth division

items.question: Which divisions of the layout correspond to the middles and tips of the petals?
premises: The third division is assigned to the petal-middles.
The fourth division is assigned to the petal-tips.
items.inference: The petal-middles are located in the third division and the petal-tips in the fourth division.
uncertainties: The exact spatial unit of division depends on the preceding layout instructions.
items.plain_english: In the third division are the middles of the petals, and in the fourth division are the tips of the petals.
